template: one proposal for one refinement step: the contract the agents exchange
contract: the template as a typed artifact: decisions, constraints, cost, precondition, program, backward map, certificate schema
precondition: the condition a design must satisfy for the refinement to be correct; the verifier's half of C3
weakest precondition: the least restrictive precondition that is still sound on the checked family; the checker's safe set equals the admitted set
weakest: least restrictive while still sound: no safe design is excluded
K1: the first well-formedness condition: the constraints C imply the precondition Pre
backward map: the map that forgets the refinement's new structure and recovers the coarser computation
obligation: one property the verifier must discharge for the refinement to be accepted
family proof: the once-per-template certification over every design the template can produce
instance check: the per-design gate: the obligations checked on the design the solver chose
family point: one setting of the schedule choices (slots, prefetch, trailing barrier) in the family sweep
regime: which resource is the bottleneck; here memory-bound or compute-bound
gate: a correctness verdict: it blocks a design and cannot be overruled
steer: a performance assumption: it may reorder the search but never prune
incumbent: the best design found so far for this workload on this chip
best so far: the incumbent: the lowest predicted cost for this workload on this chip
counterexample: a concrete failing case the checker found, replayed by an independent interpreter
replay: re-executing a counterexample with an interpreter that trusts neither the solver nor the SMT encoding
interleaving: one order in which the warps' loads, computes and barriers can execute
prefetch distance: how many tiles ahead the next load is issued
prefetch: issuing the load for a later tile while the current one is being computed
trailing barrier: a barrier after a tile's compute, before its slot may be refilled
slot: one buffer in shared memory that holds a tile of A and a tile of B
slots: the buffers in shared memory a block rotates through
tail tiles: the partial tiles at the end of a dimension that does not divide evenly by the tile size
lifetime: no slot element is overwritten between its defining write and its last read
readiness: a warp reads a slot only after every write of the tile it consumes
coverage: every output index lies in some admitted tile
exact-once: no two admitted (tile, offset) pairs denote the same index
no-phantom: no admitted (tile, offset) reaches an index beyond the extent
dual bound: the solver's proof that no feasible design does better than this value
gap: the relative distance between the best solution found and the dual bound; 0 % means proven optimal
feasible region: the set of designs that satisfy every constraint
mixed-integer linear program: an optimization problem with linear objective and constraints over integer and continuous variables
epigraph: encoding min of a max by a variable T bounded below by each term
compute-bound: the time is set by arithmetic throughput, not by memory traffic
memory-bound: the time is set by DRAM bandwidth, not by arithmetic
event model: the small explicit program (two warps, five k-phases) over which schedule obligations are checked for all interleavings
rank: the measure that decreases on every step and proves the refined program terminates with the coarse result
relation: the state relation connecting the refined execution to the coarse one
wave: one batch of thread blocks that run at once, one per SM; the kernel is as many waves as blocks / SMs
waves: batches of thread blocks, one block per SM at a time
phase: one k-step of the block: load a tile, barrier, compute from the slot
k-phase: one reduction step: the block consumes one Tk-wide tile of A and B
slot lifetime: the window from a tile's load completing to its last read, during which its slot must not be overwritten
prefetch overlap: the part of a tile load that runs while an earlier tile is being computed
leading barrier: the barrier before a phase's compute: every warp's loads of that tile are complete
block pipeline: the schedule of one thread block's loads, barriers and computes across its k-phases
